steps.senseiHelp:
Ask the ninja: 

❓ How might you connect pixels diagonally to create a staircase effect in each image’s outline?


Solution:

The ninja should place pixels diagonally on the canvas to create a staircase effect and form the shape of the image. They can use the marquee tool to increase or decrease the size of the medium carrot image, or draw their own from scratch.

Ask the ninja: 

❓What analogous colors might be used to add depth to each image?


Solution:

Analogous colors, such as brown, dark purple, and teal, should be used to replace the black pixels of each carrot image’s outline.

Ask the ninja: 

❓ Where might pixels be added to transition between colors in the large carrot image?


Solution:

The ninja should use dithering to add pixels in a spaced out diagonal pattern in the large carrot image. They should use analogous colors, like white and tan, to add a highlight, and brown, dark purple, and teal to add shading to the carrot image.
steps.instructions:
Use the paint editor to create an original pixel art image!


Use the medCarrot image asset to create smaller (8x8) and larger (32x32) versions of the same image.


Each carrot image should have an outline that uses a staircase effect to connect its pixels.


Each carrot image should be composed of several colors to add depth and to smooth the edges of its outline.


The larger image should use dithering to create highlights and shadows to transition between colors in the image.


Use the tools in the paint editor to create multiple versions of a carrot image!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 5 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about creating original pixel art images. You’ll be able to take the strategies you learn in this level to create detailed assets in future projects! Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 5:

badges.title: Pixel Artist
badges.description: Use a variety of pixel art techniques to create original pixel art assets to be used in a project.

badges.title: Work of Art
badges.description: Create and refine original pixel art images in the MakeCode paint editor.

badges.title: Neat n’ Tidy
badges.description: Create smooth outlines by removing jaggies in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Color Wheel
badges.description: Use analogous or complementary colors to modify the level of contrast in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Depth Perception
badges.description: Add highlights and shadows to make a pixel art image look realistic.

badges.title: I’m Dithering Away!
badges.description: Use dithering to ease the transition between colors in a pixel art image.

badges.title: Up to Scale
badges.description: Create and refine multiple sizes of a pixel art image.
